title: Saronic fleet cards
description: A product line-up on pale paper: a section heading with a lime button at the right, then 8px-radius photo cards with a soft shadow, a dark fade at the foot, the product's name in big light type and a mono turn-arrow link. Two 4:3 cards and a full-width panorama on desktop, one column on phones. Hover deepens the shadow, grows the photo 3% and rolls the link text.
notes: cards carry the `dark` class so names stay light over photos in either mode
mark one vessel `wide` for the full-row panorama; empty media are placeholders
CSS only; hover motion is off under reduced motion
